items.title: Deep-Reporter: Deep Research for Grounded Multimodal Long-Form Generation
items.title_zh: Deep-Reporter：面向有据可依的多模态长文生成的深度研究
items.summary: Deep-Reporter is a unified agentic framework for grounded multimodal long-form generation that combines agentic multimodal search and filtering, checklist-guided incremental synthesis and recurrent context management, trained on 8K curated agentic traces. The authors also introduce M2LongBench, 247 research tasks across nine domains in a stable multimodal sandbox, and find that post-training can narrow the gap on this difficult task.

items.title: Advertising to Agents: Measuring Description-Framing Bias in LLM Tool Selection
items.title_zh: 向智能体做广告：测量 LLM 工具选择中的描述框架偏差
items.summary: A preregistered study built pairs of tool listings differing in praise, a verifiable specification or list order and found stacked praise raised a tool's pick rate by about 43 percentage points, matching or beating a verifiable specification, while the first-listed tool was chosen about 72 points more often. A "Sponsored" label dampened the effect and a system-prompt warning moved one model, but the authors describe the results as provisional until blind phrase ratings are complete.

items.title: Do LLMs Build Spatial World Models? Evidence from Grid-World Maze Tasks
items.title_zh: 大语言模型会构建空间世界模型吗？来自网格迷宫任务的证据
items.summary: The study evaluates Gemini-2.5-Flash, GPT-5-mini, Claude-Haiku-4.5 and DeepSeek-Chat on grid-world maze tasks, finding chain-of-thought accuracy of 80-86% on small mazes with tokenized adjacency inputs but only 16-34% with visual grid formats. Despite 96-99% semantic coverage in reasoning traces, models fail to use that understanding for consistent spatial computation, suggesting representation-specific rather than format-invariant spatial reasoning.

items.title: A Benchmark for Gap and Overlap Analysis as a Test of KG Task Readiness
items.title_zh: 以缺口与重叠分析作为知识图谱任务就绪度测试的基准
items.summary: The authors release an executable benchmark for gap and overlap analysis over policy-like documents, built from ten expert-reviewed life-insurance contracts, an ontology with an instantiated knowledge base, and 58 scenarios with SPARQL queries and evidence excerpts. An ontology-driven pipeline is shown to be more consistent than a text-only LLM baseline.

items.title: NSFL: A Post-Training Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzy Logic Framework for Boolean Operators in Neural Embeddings
items.title_zh: NSFL：面向神经嵌入中布尔运算符的后训练神经符号模糊逻辑框架
items.summary: NSFL adapts formal t-norms and t-conorms to neural embedding spaces without retraining, anchoring logical operations on zero-order similarity scores while steering representations with neuro-symbolic deltas, and adds spherical query optimization for real-time retrieval. Across six encoder configurations and two modalities it reports mAP gains up to 81%, plus an additive 20% average and up to 47% boost on encoders already fine-tuned for logical reasoning.

items.title: Verify Before You Fix: Agentic Execution Grounding for Trustworthy Cross-Language Code Analysis
items.title_zh: 先验证再修复：面向可信跨语言代码分析的智能体执行锚定
items.summary: The framework runs hybrid structural-semantic detection, execution-grounded agentic validation and validation-aware iterative repair under an invariant that no repair occurs without execution-based confirmation of exploitability, using a universal AST plus fused GraphSAGE and Qwen2.5-Coder embeddings. It reports 89.84-92.02% intra-language detection accuracy, 74.43-80.12% zero-shot cross-language F1 and 69.74% end-to-end vulnerability resolution.

items.title: CheeseBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Rodent Behavioral Neuroscience Paradigms
items.title_zh: CheeseBench：在啮齿动物行为神经科学范式中评估大语言模型
items.summary: CheeseBench evaluates six open-weight LLMs on nine rodent behavioral neuroscience paradigms rendered as ASCII text, with the best model reaching 52.6% average success versus 32.1% for random agents and 78.9% for approximate rodent baselines. It finds diminishing returns beyond 7B parameters, that longer context history and chain-of-thought prompting hurt, and that performance ranges from 20% to 57% depending on interface parameters alone.

items.title: Specialty-Specific Medical Language Model for Immune-Mediated Diseases
items.title_zh: 面向免疫介导疾病的专科医学语言模型
items.summary: The authors manually annotated 371 case reports with two clinical specialists across twelve entity classes and compared NER strategies for immune-mediated and infectious disease text. A transformer trained on clinical-domain embeddings reached an F1 of 0.89, outperforming baselines and zero-shot systems, while a prompted LLM baseline performed substantially worse on span-consistent entity boundaries.
